title: Myles Garrett out of practice with lower body soreness, but Sean McVay says Rams aren't worried

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Myles Garrett out of practice with lower body soreness, but Sean McVay says Rams aren't worried
sources.description: Myles Garrett missed a third consecutive day of practice, but Rams coach Sean McVay said the defensive end has lower body soreness and nothing of concern.
